name: S2 Search with context on one shared service
description: Search with context moves onto one SearchService method shared with search, adds a REST route and a CLI command, rewrites the MCP tool as a thin adapter, and moves the context-window cap from the pipeline to config.
effort: Wide cross-layer change: service extraction, new REST route, new CLI command, MCP cutover with many pinning tests rewritten, cap removal, parity guards, many docs. No storage or migration. Risks: atomic cutover commits and shared-step extraction that must not change search.
